cases.setup: A public Python analyzer checkout has the assigned-export and annotation-only reproduction; current owner roles are initially unknown.
checks: The review record identifies current insertion, annotation classifier, export binding, and annotation test owners.
A public trace or probe records whether the annotation-only binding replaces the export binding.
The record distinguishes annotation-only declarations from declarations with assigned values.
No source or test files change during inspection.
A negative or incomplete diagnosis records FAIL or UNKNOWN and blocks edits.

cases.setup: Current owners and compatible annotation-only classification are confirmed; insertion overwrites an existing export binding.
checks: The source diff guards replacement when an existing name receives an annotation-only binding.
Current review or a public probe shows that the existing binding survives.
An absent-name annotation still inserts a binding.
A non-annotation binding still replaces the previous entry.
Scope selection and surrounding usage propagation remain unchanged.
The explicit validate Action remains required after the edit.

cases.setup: The current public annotation test owner and harness are bound to the public reproduction.
checks: The test diff contains the z import, assigned __all__, and alternative annotation-only branch.
The assertion requires no unexpected diagnostics, including no unused-import report for z.
Existing annotation tests remain present.
Syntax-version handling follows the current supported-interpreter policy.
The explicit validate Action remains required after the test edit.

cases.setup: Both edits are present and current public Oracle instructions and argv commands are bound; no hidden-test or gold-derived command is supplied.
checks: The validation record contains exact executed public commands and observed outcomes.
The focused reproduction records no unexpected diagnostics and no unused-import report for z when passing.
Relevant current public annotation tests have their actual outcomes recorded.
Review or public probes establish ordinary replacement, absent-name annotation insertion, and annotation-with-value assignment semantics.
Scope selection and usage propagation are checked against current pre-edit evidence.
Invalidated facts are refreshed rather than reused as stale observations.
Any failure is recorded as failure rather than as the intended passing effect.
The record does not claim whole-project or cross-project verification from changed-test-only qualification.
